summary.text: Arlette Hidalgo is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the September 9, 2026 Democratic primary, and Ballotpedia lists Clean Water Action and Planned Parenthood Votes! Rhode Island among her endorsers.
